run_detail.final_report_title: 研究报告：比较 OpenTelemetry 与 Prometheus 的指标数据模型，引用官方文档。
run_detail.final_report_markdown:
# OpenTelemetry 与 Prometheus 指标数据模型比较：基于官方文档的核验

本次核验的资料显示，OpenTelemetry 与 Prometheus 的指标数据模型并不冲突：OpenTelemetry 明确规定了与 Prometheus 及 Statsd 暴露格式之间的转换，并可无歧义地转换为 Prometheus Remote Write 协议而不丢失特性或语义。两者的差异主要体现在机制层面——OpenTelemetry 的指标点聚合 temporality 可为 cumulative 或 delta，而 Prometheus 的 counter 单调递增；Prometheus 通过 OpenMetrics 暴露格式支持 Exemplars，OpenTelemetry 则规定在 Sum 转换为 Prometheus Counter 时按专门章节转换 Exemplars，否则应丢弃。此外，Prometheus 侧重经典直方图与原生直方图，OpenTelemetry 还定义了通过 callback 注册的 Asynchronous Counter 等仪表类型。

## 直接回答

本次核验的资料显示，OpenTelemetry 指标数据模型与 Prometheus 之间存在明确、规范的互译路径。资料表明，流行的既有指标数据格式可以在不丢失语义或保真度的情况下无歧义地翻译为 OpenTelemetry 指标数据模型，来自 Prometheus 和 Statsd 暴露格式的转换被显式规定；同时，该数据模型也可通过定义良好的转换无歧义地映射到 Prometheus Remote Write 协议，不丢失特性或语义。 [evidence:dade4d6c1d437289cf25a3fb22d453c58a86da20d5e4b0ea] [evidence:ad5a440a76b343d90cf4fc4007de97d3a8afce56520abb8f] [evidence:e1b6d15938ee3a721a808ab08055c845f5a6f99e9b83d5a2] [evidence:08abd6b5e9065a892ce9421f844130c9fdbc43479ce84bda] [evidence:6739fa53caa7a35d46187221f56ea3104df70035b465aa68]

在聚合 temporality 上，两者的表述不同。资料显示，OTLP 指标点的聚合 temporality 可为 cumulative 或 delta，转换规则据此区分：若聚合 temporality 为 cumulative 且 sum 单调，则必须转换为 Prometheus Counter。而 Prometheus 侧的 counter 被描述为单调递增、记录事件的运行总量。 [evidence:ad0c69d05966f4bdb78e5821950221f5f7911963d99338ad] [evidence:cb081711f861c433cba13f25ecc3a4492a31a1b834983877]

Exemplars 方面，Prometheus 使用 OpenMetrics 公开格式来支持范例。OpenTelemetry 的规定则与转换相关：若 Sum 被转换为 Prometheus Counter，则 Exemplars 必须按 Exemplar Conversion 章节所述进行转换；否则，Exemplars 应被丢弃。 [evidence:acd8853111794fdabcb12246f6c66bd31574bf1e20f234a7] [evidence:4bdae7307de4a78781ae9c9716088739f5d64978462d9ea6]

在指标仪表类型与标识方式上，资料各有侧重。OpenTelemetry 定义了 Asynchronous Counter，通过 callback 以惯用接口报告测量值，并在创建时注册；其命名建议指出，当指标属于特定系统（项目、提供方、产品）时，仪表名应以系统名开头，遵循 `{system_name}.*.{metric_name}` 模式，并提到溢出测量被聚合为以属性 `otel.metric.overflow=true` 标识的单个 overflow data point。Prometheus 侧则定义了原生直方图这一更高效的直方图形式；经典直方图由多条时间序列组成，以 `_bucket{le=""}` 暴露的累计计数器、`_sum` 暴露的和以及 `_count` 暴露的计数来标识样本。 [evidence:dbbc7d9dfd78436333afc12a890e394259c492adb33d7b55] [evidence:2937008a33635c0ed98cc7486f7d2384688f5c4c2821d246] [evidence:321aab330667b5841d256109bc1fe65bbce4ae7e125fc996] [evidence:b323ffb9dcbb8b3270bb507afe5ade2e0da7d67fc2ebe7e1] [evidence:eefddd9bc71b3b05ab45f5fe55badf0eb5e0e2f2c9de2b50]

## 对比表

| 比较维度 | OpenTelemetry 指标数据模型 | Prometheus 数据模型 |
| --- | --- | --- |
| 聚合 temporality | 指标点的聚合 temporality 可为 cumulative 或 delta，转换规则据此区分 | counter 单调递增，记录事件的运行总量 [evidence:ad0c69d05966f4bdb78e5821950221f5f7911963d99338ad] [evidence:cb081711f861c433cba13f25ecc3a4492a31a1b834983877] |
| 互操作与转换 | 既有流行格式可无歧义译为该模型而不丢失语义或保真度；显式规定 Prometheus 与 Statsd 暴露格式的转换；可无歧义转为 Prometheus Remote Write 协议而不丢失特性或语义 | 该数据模型可经定义良好的转换无歧义映射到 Prometheus Remote Write 协议而不丢失特性或语义；显式规定 Prometheus 与 Statsd 暴露格式的转换 [evidence:dade4d6c1d437289cf25a3fb22d453c58a86da20d5e4b0ea] [evidence:ad5a440a76b343d90cf4fc4007de97d3a8afce56520abb8f] [evidence:e1b6d15938ee3a721a808ab08055c845f5a6f99e9b83d5a2] [evidence:08abd6b5e9065a892ce9421f844130c9fdbc43479ce84bda] [evidence:6739fa53caa7a35d46187221f56ea3104df70035b465aa68] |
| Exemplars 支持 | Sum 转为 Prometheus Counter 时 Exemplars 必须按 Exemplar Conversion 章节转换，否则应丢弃 | 使用 OpenMetrics 公开格式来支持范例（Exemplars） [evidence:4bdae7307de4a78781ae9c9716088739f5d64978462d9ea6] [evidence:acd8853111794fdabcb12246f6c66bd31574bf1e20f234a7] |
| 指标仪表类型 | 定义 Asynchronous Counter，通过 callback 报告测量值并在创建时注册 | 定义原生直方图（native histograms）这一更高效的直方图形式 [evidence:dbbc7d9dfd78436333afc12a890e394259c492adb33d7b55] [evidence:b323ffb9dcbb8b3270bb507afe5ade2e0da7d67fc2ebe7e1] |
| 指标与标签标识 | 系统特定指标名建议以系统名开头，遵循 `{system_name}.*.{metric_name}` 模式；溢出测量聚合为 `otel.metric.overflow=true` 标识的单个 overflow data point | 经典直方图由多条时间序列组成，以 `_bucket{le=""}` 累计计数器、`_sum` 和 `_count` 标识样本 [evidence:2937008a33635c0ed98cc7486f7d2384688f5c4c2821d246] [evidence:321aab330667b5841d256109bc1fe65bbce4ae7e125fc996] [evidence:eefddd9bc71b3b05ab45f5fe55badf0eb5e0e2f2c9de2b50] |

## Citation audit

### OpenTelemetry metrics data model · Aggregation temporality

- Evidence: `evidence:ad0c69d05966f4bdb78e5821950221f5f7911963d99338ad`
- Exact quote: “* If the aggregation temporality is cumulative and the sum is monotonic, it MUST be converted to a Prometheus Counter.”
- Snapshot: `research/external/e4b26025-534c-42fa-8144-70f405e59915/1ddcd3df7746d25266afc5e5a523740c6c92ac8ae298b0b11dd2bb51ec2f43fe`
- URL: https://opentelemetry.io/docs/specs/otel/compatibility/prometheus_and_openmetrics/

### OpenTelemetry metrics data model · Interoperability and translation

- Evidence: `evidence:dade4d6c1d437289cf25a3fb22d453c58a86da20d5e4b0ea`
- Exact quote: “Popular existing metrics data formats can be unambiguously translated into the OpenTelemetry data model for metrics, without loss of semantics or fidelity.”
- Snapshot: `research/external/e4b26025-534c-42fa-8144-70f405e59915/b7ccf2e3522537adab72dd8ee02cfb730f9203cfaf989613570aaf0d4c43f82a`
- URL: https://opentelemetry.io/docs/specs/otel/metrics/data-model/

### OpenTelemetry metrics data model · Exemplars support

- Evidence: `evidence:4bdae7307de4a78781ae9c9716088739f5d64978462d9ea6`
- Exact quote: “If Sum is converted to a Prometheus Counter, then `Exemplars` MUST be converted as described in the [Exemplar Conversion](#exemplar-conversion) section. Otherwise, `Exemplars` SHOULD be dropped.”
- Snapshot: `research/external/e4b26025-534c-42fa-8144-70f405e59915/1ddcd3df7746d25266afc5e5a523740c6c92ac8ae298b0b11dd2bb51ec2f43fe`
- URL: https://opentelemetry.io/docs/specs/otel/compatibility/prometheus_and_openmetrics/

### OpenTelemetry metrics data model · Metric instrument types

- Evidence: `evidence:dbbc7d9dfd78436333afc12a890e394259c492adb33d7b55`
- Exact quote: “Asynchronous Counter uses an idiomatic interface for reporting measurements through a `callback`, which is registered during [Asynchronous Counter creation](#asynchronous-counter-creation).”
- Snapshot: `research/external/be22c417-367b-4b08-bd33-1e11904dd34b/f110face558e87129abb02f271e17fe407274ac9b8e0f475117d87c8d4046e2a`
- URL: https://opentelemetry.io/docs/specs/otel/metrics/api/

### OpenTelemetry metrics data model · Metric and label identification

- Evidence: `evidence:2937008a33635c0ed98cc7486f7d2384688f5c4c2821d246`
- Exact quote: “When a metric is specific to a system (project, provider, product), the corresponding instrument name SHOULD start with the system name following the `{system_name}.*.{metric_name}` pattern.”
- Snapshot: `research/external/d22e2dda-e6e9-4eaf-8e3b-901fc3616415/c191db24098dda6239df083d0243ceedf7aa07f504a2e20ac81da7ac98681dab`
- URL: https://opentelemetry.io/docs/specs/semconv/general/naming/

### Prometheus data model · Aggregation temporality

- Evidence: `evidence:cb081711f861c433cba13f25ecc3a4492a31a1b834983877`
- Exact quote: “A counter increases monotonically.”
- Snapshot: `research/external/9da21f92-8f7f-411f-b062-6d9c70d5fc33/43a83b80659a61fa11ed35e27368e22458c38e4238f98a21e6914456931bfe26`
- URL: https://last9.io/blog/prometheus-metrics-types-a-deep-dive/

### Prometheus data model · Interoperability and translation

- Evidence: `evidence:08abd6b5e9065a892ce9421f844130c9fdbc43479ce84bda`
- Exact quote: “The data model can be unambiguously translated into the Prometheus Remote Write protocol without loss of features or semantics, through well-defined translations of the data”
- Snapshot: `research/external/9da21f92-8f7f-411f-b062-6d9c70d5fc33/e54bff7a6775de70afccba736b198cf859fa96d8934ecd094750d9102105f5c9`
- URL: https://opentelemetry.io/docs/specs/otel/metrics/data-model/

### Prometheus data model · Exemplars support

- Evidence: `evidence:acd8853111794fdabcb12246f6c66bd31574bf1e20f234a7`
- Exact quote: “Prometheus 中使用 [OpenMetrics 公开格式](https://github.com/OpenObservability/OpenMetrics/blob/main/specification/OpenMetrics.md)来支持范例。”
- Snapshot: `research/external/e33ca8bb-545d-4955-a977-b188efaec0f7/c8482a156f6d44a4c12a8cb771dc53e3a16d852e6f3173a8e3ab24e3bb150e0c`
- URL: https://docs.cloud.google.com/stackdriver/docs/managed-prometheus/exemplars?hl=zh-cn

### Prometheus data model · Metric instrument types

- Evidence: `evidence:b323ffb9dcbb8b3270bb507afe5ade2e0da7d67fc2ebe7e1`
- Exact quote: “Native histograms are generally much more efficient than classic histograms, allow much higher resolution, do not require explicit configuration of bucket boundaries during instrumentation”
- Snapshot: `research/external/3d0663bd-ff71-4f18-b63e-ee8d95dc587a/a04bd7505cbe270e4898e566014fa8528a136830ab0bbadc37b2ba0d3afcb721`
- URL: https://prometheus.io/docs/concepts/metric_types/

### Prometheus data model · Metric and label identification

- Evidence: `evidence:eefddd9bc71b3b05ab45f5fe55badf0eb5e0e2f2c9de2b50`
- Exact quote: “* cumulative counters for the observation buckets, exposed as `_bucket{le=""}`”
- Snapshot: `research/external/3d0663bd-ff71-4f18-b63e-ee8d95dc587a/a04bd7505cbe270e4898e566014fa8528a136830ab0bbadc37b2ba0d3afcb721`
- URL: https://prometheus.io/docs/concepts/metric_types/

  - URL: https://opentelemetry.io/docs/specs/otel/metrics/data-model/

  - Snapshot: `research/external/9da21f92-8f7f-411f-b062-6d9c70d5fc33/e54bff7a6775de70afccba736b198cf859fa96d8934ecd094750d9102105f5c9`

columns.label: Aggregation temporality
columns.description: Whether the model records cumulative or delta values over time and how temporality is specified.

columns.label: Interoperability and translation
columns.description: How the two models map to each other and what each official doc says about converting or translating between them.

columns.label: Exemplars support
columns.description: Whether the model supports exemplars attaching trace context to metric measurements and how.

columns.label: Metric instrument types
columns.description: What metric instrument or metric types the model defines (e.g. counters, gauges, histograms) and how they are named and classified.

columns.label: Metric and label identification
columns.description: How a metric series is uniquely identified (metric name plus labels/attributes) and the naming and attribute/label rules each model imposes.

brief.scope: Metric instrument types, aggregation temporality, metric/label identity, exemplars, and interoperability between the two models.
